events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries increasing. The US has shown military strength, but its geopolitical power is waning. This could lead to a regional war, affecting global markets.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will lead to increased volatility in global markets, with a potential safe haven bid in gold. Emerging markets may be negatively affected due to their exposure to geopolitical risks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US-Iran relations and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when US-Iran tensions ease or gold price drops below $1500

events.title: Nvidia Earnings Report
events.summary: Nvidia's Q1 earnings report has surpassed Wall Street expectations, driven by massive AI chip demand. This could lead to a surge in AI semiconductor stocks.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's strong earnings report will boost AI semiconductor stocks, with the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF being a key beneficiary. Rotating into Nvidia Corporation may also be a good strategy.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Nvidia's stock price and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when Nvidia's stock price drops below $200

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Fed is unlikely to cut interest rates until the second half of 2027, with most officials embracing the possibility of higher rates if inflation stays elevated.
events.reasoning: The US Fed's decision to keep interest rates high will lead to a surge in the US dollar and a drop in long-term Treasury yields. This will negatively affect long-term Treasury bonds, while boosting the US stock market.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US inflation data and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when US inflation drops below 2%
